text: Meet the Zivs. Small AI agents that live on a FalkorDB graph of your real work, and act on it, with your permission. This is ZivBot.
Here's a brand new account, with zero chats. Ziv says hello, asks what to call me, and then asks me to connect my world.
Connecting is one click, the way it works in Claude or ChatGPT. Sign in with Google. I pick my account in the browser, and my Gmail and Calendar stream straight into my own FalkorDB graph.
Then, Sign in with GitHub. My most recent repositories, with their contributors, issues, pull requests and files, are mapped in and linked to me.
Here is that graph. Email threads, people, repositories, files and issues become nodes and edges. Every user gets their own isolated graph, with full text and vector indexes built in.
FalkorDB's own algorithms run as tools the Zivs can call. PageRank finds who sits at the center of my work. Label propagation finds who really works together.
Now a real question. Which emails haven't I replied to? The graph planner answers instantly, straight from my inbox, newest first.
Show path opens the exact Cypher behind that answer, with row counts and timings. No black box, ever.
And I can pick the model, per chat. Here it's Codex, on my own ChatGPT subscription. It calls ZivBot's graph tools over MCP, and its Cypher still lands under the answer.
Or Claude, on my Claude plan. Same graph, same tools, a different brain. It follows the contributor edges and answers.
Zivs act, but only with my approval. Draft a reply. The draft waits right here. Nothing is sent until I approve it, and then it goes out through my real Gmail.
Zivs are cheap to make. I add Ledger, a finance Ziv, from a template. They all share one graph memory, and they message each other.
Now my phone. This QR code opens an end to end encrypted channel to this laptop, over Supabase Realtime. It works from any network, as long as the laptop is on.
On the iPhone, it's the same Zivs and the same graph, answering from my laptop, wherever I am.
And every graph tool is an MCP server too. Here, a real Codex session calls ZivBot's triage tool on my graph. ZivBot. Agents that act on your real, connected data, with FalkorDB at the center.
